fieldNotes.tenancy: ROSTER NOTE CONFIRMED: the building at 1545 E Locust St, Bldg 7 (Thoroughbred Business Park Phase II, APN 0113-441-12, ~268,830 sq ft, built 1997/98) is now branded and operated by Smart Warehousing, a 3PL — Street View (Feb/May 2025) shows a 'Smart Warehousing' sign on the office face. The EPA RMP 'Ontario Distribution Center' historically tied SC Johnson aerosol storage to this address; SCJ's current direct tenancy here is doubtful — likely a 3PL-operated DC that may still handle SCJ aerosol product or have transitioned. Audited as the physical RDC site per the roster.
fieldNotes.location: Confirmed via EPA RMP record (Ontario Distribution Center) + LoopNet APN listing (0113-441-12, 1545 E Locust St) + Smart Warehousing 'Ontario #2' warehouse listing. Roster geocode moved 125 m and lands on the correct building.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Street View (May 2022) of the truck yard on the west side shows a clear sliding/cantilever gate across the truck driveway, with chain-link fence flanking it and FedEx trailers parked inside the fenced yard. Controlled truck entrance.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed multi-window guard booth at the gate; a small structure sits at the SW corner of the truck yard near the gate but it is not a road-side staffed booth.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Truck gate present, no guard shack -> remote check-in (kiosk/badge/app) implied.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock banks on the WEST face (continuous bank fronting the fenced truck drop yard) and the SOUTH face -> shipping and receiving on physically separate building faces.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Continuous dock bank along the ~150m west face plus a shorter bank on the south face -> 25-50 band for a ~268k sq ft DC.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Fenced truck drop yard along the west face holds a moderate number of trailers without tractors -> 10-25.
fieldNotes.trailersVisible: Imagery shows a modest count of trailers (some FedEx) in the west yard; count approximate.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Truck yard is functional but compact, squeezed between buildings; no clear unused width for an express lane -> false.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Dense Inland Empire industrial fabric in Ontario CA -- wall-to-wall large distribution buildings in every direction -> Urban.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Estimate from perimeter box; ~268,830 sq ft building on a compact ~13-acre parcel.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Single gated truck drive; lane count approximate.
